items.title: Quantum Alliance forms amid warnings 6.4 million bitcoin face future quantum threat
items.summary: Nine crypto companies launched the Quantum Alliance to jointly prepare for quantum attacks, but they disagree on when the threat will arrive and whether vulnerable BTC should be frozen.

items.title: Hut 8 Funnels $161 Million in Bitcoin to Exchanges

Following the Coins The trail starts in custody, and Arkham labelled the source addresses as Hut 8's Coinbase Prime custody wallets. From there, the coins hopped to a single intermediary address…

items.title: Scammer gets scammed in Ledger spy-chip exploit, loses almost $5 million in bitcoin
items.summary: Chainalysis says a fraudster who tricked people through fake online jobs became one of the biggest victims of the compromised hardware wallets.

items.title: Capital B posts wider H1 net loss of $78 million on bitcoin impairment charge

items.title: Bitcoin may seek 20-month trend line reclaim before new record highs: CryptoQuant
items.summary: Bitcoin's market cycle signals tool showed BTC price action copying history, possibly preparing to reclaim a key moving average before testing new highs.

items.title: MSCI approves rules that could eject Strategy, Metaplanet from equity indexes
items.summary: The rules proposed in August would see companies that exist mainly to hold investments as no longer eligible for index inclusion.

items.title: Capital B reports $78M H1 loss driven by Bitcoin impairment charge
items.summary: Europe's second-largest Bitcoin treasury raised $30 million and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11% in the first half of 2026, despite reporting a $75 million Bitcoin impairment loss.
